title: Run to sanctuary before fear hardens
summary: Fear is met by sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency. Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
takeaway: Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Fear is met by sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency.
source.lifeApplication: In the first surge of fear, ask for shelter before strategy takes over.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear is met by sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.
